quests.title: Isles of Invention
quests.summary: Dr Bethan Howells is making a Timeline of Invention and needs legs: from the Manchester Baby to the codebreakers of Bletchley Park.

steps.text: Read the plaque about the Manchester Baby, by Dr Howells.
Show Dr Howells you can count like the Baby: light the right binary lamps.
Go to Bletchley Park, east out of Oxford, and read its plaque.
Crack the practice cipher in Hut 8.
Take a proper look at Colossus in Block H.
Tell Dr Howells in Manchester what you saw.

quests.reward: Three Silver Snares, a Cream Tea, and a Timeline of Invention that keeps on giving.

quests.title: Plain Words
quests.summary: Dr Rao, who teaches computers by example near King's Cross, wants to see if you can tell what AI is from what it isn't.

steps.text: Read the DeepMind plaque by King's Cross Station.
Answer Dr Rao's three questions about what a model can and can't do.

quests.reward: Two Flasks of Tea, two Silver Snares, and AI in plain words on your Timeline.

quests.title: Four Irish Scientists
quests.summary: Professor Brennan at Trinity College Dublin wants four Irish scientists the world forgot to mention found on their plaques.

steps.text: Find Robert Boyle's plaque in the Comeraghs, County Waterford.
Find Ernest Walton's plaque in the Comeraghs.
Find Jocelyn Bell Burnell's plaque by Lough Neagh.
Find Kathleen Lonsdale's plaque in Dublin.
Go back to Professor Brennan at Trinity College.

quests.reward: Two Kendal Mint Cakes and two Silver Snares.
